title: Dashboard Snapshot Extension — Role Utilization
description: New field added to the dashboard SSE snapshot for per-role performer utilization (spec 048).

role_utilization.description: Per-role utilization data for the dashboard.

active.description: Number of currently active performer instances for this role.

max.description: Configured max_concurrency for this role (clamped to 1 for singletons).

queued.description: Number of cards waiting for a free slot in this role. 0 when not at capacity.
